A little help before you order

Your questions, answered.

How do I confirm my order?

Send your cake enquiry on WhatsApp or email. We’ll discuss your design, date and final quote. Sending the form is an enquiry; the bakery will explain how to confirm your order and any payment required.

Where can I collect, and do you deliver?

Collect your cake at Nyayo Embakasi, Gate A. Delivery is available around Nairobi for a fee. Include your area in the planner so we can quote the delivery charge and arrange the details with you.

How early should I order?

Share your celebration date as early as you can. Ask us to confirm the notice required for your design and whether your date is available.

How much cake will I need?

Portions depend on cake height and slice size. Enter your guest count and choose “Help me choose a weight” for a recommendation from the bakery.

Can I request a different design or mention allergies?

Yes—add an inspiration link, colours and dietary requirements to your enquiry. Attach additional photos when WhatsApp or email opens. Discuss ingredients and allergy requirements with us before confirming.

What about changes, cancellations and cake care?

Please ask the bakery about changes, cancellation terms and deposits before confirming. Request storage and transport instructions suited to your cake when arranging collection or delivery.
